item.title: Why violent crime plummeted in the U.S. in 2025
item.description: Violent crime plummeted in 2025 with the murder rate falling 18% from its 2024 level, according to the FBI's annual crime report. Adam Gelb, president and CEO at the Council on Criminal Justice, joins CBS News to discuss the reason for the fall.

item.title: Teens may have found a new way to detect Lyme disease | 60 Minutes Archive
item.description: The CDC says Lyme disease is emerging beyond the regions where it has historically been considered endemic. In 2025, 60 Minutes' Bill Whitaker reported on high school students researching a new way to detect and treat the disease.

item.title: Inside Americans' views on socialism and capitalism
item.description: A new CBS News poll shows 58% of Democrats view socialism positively while 50% view capitalism negatively. CBS News' Anthony Salvanto breaks down the findings.

item.title: Lindsay Clancy's mother testifies "she had thoughts of harming the children"
item.description: Lindsay Clancy's Massachusetts murder trial resumed Monday in Plymouth Superior Court. Clancy's mother and sister were on the stand after the prosecution rested its case.

item.title: Breaking down Florida's top primary races, including Wasserman Schultz's run in a new district
item.description: CBS News Miami's Jim DeFede joins CBS News to break down some of the biggest primary battles in Florida on Tuesday.

item.title: Trump threatens Oman, Iran war in stalemate as 60-day talks window ends
item.description: The 60-day deadline for the U.S. and Iran to negotiate a peace deal and reopen the Strait of Hormuz is expiring, with no agreement in sight.

item.title: Trump orders military to reduce exercises with South Korea
item.description: President Trump announced over the weekend that he's ordered the Pentagon to reduce joint military exercises with South Korea, saying that the country recently declined to join U.S. efforts to denuclearize Iran. CBS News' Nancy Cordes reports.

item.title: Latest on Iran war, 60 days after U.S. and Iran signed memorandum that called for peace talks
item.description: It has been 60 days since the U.S. and Iran signed a memorandum of understanding that was meant to be the first step in a wider peace process, but in those 60 days negotiators have made virtually no progress on a permanent end to the war. CBS News' Charlie D'Agata, Aaron MacLean and Nancy Cordes have the latest on the war.

item.title: Extended interview: Becky G on her music, her rise to fame and more
item.description: Becky G speaks with Gayle King about the latest developments in her career, her new music, the intersection of advocacy and art in her latest videos and more.

item.title: Trial starts in Microsoft exec's murder allegedly hatched by ex-wife
item.description: Jared Bridegan was repeatedly shot outside his vehicle while his 2-year-old child was strapped in a car seat.

item.title: School vaccination rates inch down again to record low
item.description: U.S. kindergarten vaccination rates have declined again, with exemptions reaching a record high for the 2025-2026 school year

item.title: School uses AI instead of teachers for personalized learning: Co-founder breaks it down
item.description: Alpha School is a private school that teaches students subjects like math and reading with artificial intelligence apps. Mackenzie Price, co-founder of Alpha School, joins CBS News to discuss.

item.title: Luigi Mangione's New York trial delayed
item.description: Luigi Mangione's New York state trial on second-degree murder charges is being delayed.

item.title: Protests grow over Flock camera use in communities
item.description: More Americans are pushing back against police use of Flock surveillance cameras. Part of the concern comes from reports of officers misusing the cameras to stalk civilians, including ex-wives and girlfriends. CBS News' Anna Schecter interviewed Flock CEO Garrett Langley last week and has more.

item.title: Stellantis recalls nearly 850,000 vehicles over rearview camera issue
item.description: The car manufacturer is also recalling another 107,000 vehicles outside the U.S. over the same issue.

item.title: Penn State frat brothers charged with running cocaine trafficking ring
item.description: Two Penn State fraternities are at the center of a cocaine trafficking ring bust, leading to charges against 14 people, authorities said.

item.title: Where the Trump administration's lawsuits seeking voter data stand
item.description: The Justice Department has filed lawsuits against 30 states and the District of Columbia in an effort to force them to hand over their unredacted voter rolls containing voters' sensitive information.

item.title: House Ethics investigating Rep. Gomez for alleged sexual misconduct
item.description: The allegations include "engaging in inappropriate sexual contact with a House staffer," according to the committee.

item.title: Tupac Shakur was murdered in "act of revenge," prosecutor tells jury
item.description: The long-unsolved drive-by shooting gripped the hip-hop community, partly because no one was charged until Duane "Keffe D" Davis was indicted in 2023.

item.title: Hegseth to go to Iowa today to campaign for GOP candidates, sources say
item.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth was scheduled to head to Iowa on Monday to give remarks, speak to veterans and campaign, sources told CBS News.

item.title: Trump welcomes 16-year-old lifeguard and boy he rescued to the Oval Office
item.description: President Trump praised lifeguard Ryder Williams for his bravery, saying his rescue of a 10-year-old boy in treacherous waters was "incredible."

item.title: Watch: Trump meets with hero lifeguard, takes questions on Iran, USS Lincoln and more
item.description: President Trump on Monday met with 16-year-old Ryder Williams, the lifeguard who saved a 10-year-old boy who was struggling in rough surf on a California beach. During the Oval Office meeting, the president also took questions from reporters on Iran, conditions aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln and more.

item.title: Has your license plate been tracked by Flock? Here's how to check.
item.description: The website​ HaveIBeenFlocked has compiled a database of 4.6 million license plate records that have appeared in roughly 242 million Flock searches.

item.title: Retired Marine colonel on Trump threat to bomb Oman: "Pretty extraordinary"
item.description: Mark Cancian, retired Marine colonel and senior adviser at the Center for Strategic and International Studies, joins CBS News to discuss President Trump's threat to bomb Oman if it "gets in the way" of efforts to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Notable Deaths in 2026
item.description: A look back at the esteemed personalities who've left us this year, who'd touched us with their innovation, creativity and humanity.

item.title: Hayden Panettiere, known for "Heroes" and "Remember the Titans," dies at 36
item.description: Hayden Panettiere, who starred in "Remember the Titans" as a child actor and rose to fame in the series "Heroes," has died at the age of 36. The coroner's office says she was found in cardiac arrest.

item.title: Jared Kushner met with Hamas leaders in Egypt to discuss Gaza peace deal
item.description: Jared Kushner, who is President Trump's son-in-law, is set to meet next with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, who rejected the latest peace proposal last week.

item.title: Hayden Panettiere remembered by co-stars and friends after her death
item.description: Co-stars and friends of Hayden Panettiere​ are remembering her for her friendship, intelligence and talent after her shocking death on Sunday.

item.title: Trump orders Pentagon to "substantially reduce" exercises with South Korea
item.description: President Trump said Sunday that the joint military exercises with South Korea are costly and they "send a signal that is totally inappropriate and hostile" to North Korea.

item.title: Becky G reflects on advocacy in new music, rise to fame
item.description: Becky G spoke exclusively with "CBS Mornings" co-host Gayle King about her rise to fame, being the breadwinner of the family at a young age and her new music.
